failures_retained: Prior Linux and macOS binaries time out in the same final native host-backpressure fixture

First macOS fixture used a receive buffer below sender low-water mark; independent socket-pair control proves writable-event suppression despite a one-byte write succeeding. Corrected fixture retains native socket defaults.
First regression wrappers omitted required memory output argument; separate corrected runs pass all ten profiles on both hosts.
migration: Ordinary TX streams preserve their old wire format in both directions. A host-pending shift uses an optional subsection; an older destination rejects it explicitly. GLib watch IDs remain local resources. External socket queues are outside VMState and require a coordinated transport handoff.
limitations: Register/frame-level virtual UART and actual host-byte-stream controls; serial-bit errors, IrDA, DMA, clock tree and pin mux remain unfinished
RP1 remains a separate endpoint on ARM virt; raspi5b BCM2712 PCIe/RP1 board integration is not supplied by this repair
